Container.Name: JLTamp-Server
Container.Overview: Self-hosted music server with its own apps for Android, iOS, CarPlay and Android Auto, and a web player built in. Multi-user with per-user libraries, Listen Together, a 24/7 radio, karaoke, party mode and a Subsonic/OpenSubsonic API for clients such as Symfonium and Feishin. Your music is mounted read-only; everything the server writes goes to /data.[br][br]After the first start, open the WebUI to create the admin account, then add a library under Settings, Libraries.

Config.Name: WebUI and API port
Config.Description: Port for the web player, the apps and the Subsonic API. Plex uses 32400 too: pick another host port if Plex runs on this server.

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Your music share. Mounted read-only: the server never writes to it.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, artwork cache and nightly backups.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS address if you expose the server, used in mails, party links and the Spotify callback. Leave empty on a LAN-only setup.

Config.Name: Open registration
Config.Description: true lets anyone register; otherwise accounts are by invitation.

Config.Name: Playlist importer
Config.Description: true enables rebuilding Spotify playlists from a link (official API, your own key).

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Optional, for invitations and password resets.
